description: A DMN decision table becomes an AWA decision table: hit policy, columns with their types, FEEL unary tests as AWA entries, FEEL literals as values.
dmn:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<definitions xmlns="https://www.omg.org/spec/DMN/20191111/MODEL/" xmlns:awa="https://awa.io/schema/interchange/1.1" id="Definitions_entries" name="Decisions" namespace="https://example.com/dmn">
<decision id="Decision_terms" name="Terms">
<description>Terms of a loan.</description>
<decisionTable id="DT" hitPolicy="FIRST">
<input id="I1" label="Score"><inputExpression id="IE1" typeRef="integer"><text>score</text></inputExpression></input>
<input id="I2"><inputExpression id="IE2" typeRef="string"><text>segment</text></inputExpression></input>
<input id="I3"><inputExpression id="IE3" typeRef="date"><text>start date</text></inputExpression></input>
<output id="O1" name="rate" typeRef="double"/>
<output id="O2" name="note" label="Note" typeRef="string"/>
<rule id="R1"><description>Excellent</description><inputEntry id="a1"><text>[700..850]</text></inputEntry><inputEntry id="a2"><text>"gold","platinum"</text></inputEntry><inputEntry id="a3"><text>>= date("2024-01-01")</text></inputEntry><outputEntry id="a4"><text>3.5</text></outputEntry><outputEntry id="a5"><text>"best rate"</text></outputEntry></rule>
<rule id="R2"><inputEntry id="b1"><text>]600..700[</text></inputEntry><inputEntry id="b2"><text>not("blocked")</text></inputEntry><inputEntry id="b3"><text>-</text></inputEntry><outputEntry id="b4"><text>4.5</text></outputEntry><outputEntry id="b5"><text>null</text></outputEntry></rule>
<rule id="R3"><inputEntry id="c1"><text>? < 600</text></inputEntry><inputEntry id="c2"><text>starts with(?, "pro")</text></inputEntry><inputEntry id="c3"><text>not(null)</text></inputEntry><outputEntry id="c4"><text>6</text></outputEntry><outputEntry id="c5"><text>"review"</text></outputEntry></rule>
<rule id="R4"><inputEntry id="d1"><text>null</text></inputEntry><inputEntry id="d2"><text>contains(?, "x"), matches(?, "^a")</text></inputEntry><inputEntry id="d3"><text>= date("2025-06-30")</text></inputEntry><outputEntry id="d4"><text>0</text></outputEntry><outputEntry id="d5"><text>"it's"</text></outputEntry></rule>
</decisionTable>
</decision>
</definitions>
